author: Praxis III
title: SoftPower‑DAQB MPB: p=1.5, tau_q=0.70, δ=0.11, kd=20, k=48
abstract: Soft‑threshold power schedule γ_j = min(γ_max, λ·max(R²_j−τ,0)^1.5) with τ at the 70th percentile of R² and λ chosen by mean‑target (0.04). Increase δ to 0.11 to test cross‑batch mixing gains. MPB‑GraphFWPCA (α_g=0.5, PCA50) + DAQB (kd=20, k=48).

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage')
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from softpower_daqb_mpb import eliminate_softpower_daqb_mpb

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return eliminate_softpower_daqb_mpb(
        adata,
        p_exp=1.5,
        tau_mode='quantile',
        tau_q=0.70,
        delta=0.11,
        kdensity=20,
        k_total=48
    )
